Backs the 2027 lineups of the eight Circuito Desafiante teams. The author supplied Brazilian and Spanish-speaking rosters from Leaguepedia screenshots, required Estral Esports and 7REX to field only Spanish-speaking players, and asked that surplus players not be created.
